question: According to the rule of supply when the value of the product decreases, the quantity of supply-
solution:
The correct answer is __**Decrease**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the rule of supply, when the value of the product decreases, the quantity of supply **decreases**.
 
• This relationship is fundamental to the law of supply in economics, which states that, all else being equal, an increase in the price of a good will result in an increase in the quantity supplied.
 
• Conversely, a decrease in the price of a good will result in a decrease in the quantity supplied.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The law of supply is one of the basic principles of economics, and it is typically represented by an upward-sloping supply curve on a graph, where the x-axis represents quantity and the y-axis represents price.
 
• Factors other than price that can affect supply include production costs, technology, and the prices of related goods.
 
• Understanding the law of supply helps businesses and policymakers predict how changes in the market can affect production and availability of goods.
